description: Pins the B2B member vault-unlock password KEK derivation (derive_person_vault_member_unlock_key: Argon2id over the password under salt domain 'myne.v0.2 argon2id-person-vault-member-unlock|' with a per-device random salt and the vault account_number_hash in the domain scope) and the vault.member-unlock AAD (aad_person_member_unlock_store: 'person-member-unlock-store' role, vault_id || account_number_hash, v0.2 prefix). A port that frames either differently derives a key that opens nothing, or an AAD that fails every open. EXPECTED RUNTIME: ~3s (Argon2id at canonical params). Generated by `cargo test -p protocol --test vectors emit_person_member_unlock -- --ignored --nocapture`.

cases.description: The member vault-unlock key: Argon2id(password) under the member-unlock salt domain with the per-device salt and the vault's account_number_hash. Changing the password, the salt, the domain prefix, or the account hash changes the key.

The vault.member-unlock AAD: v0.2 prefix || protocol byte || length-prefixed role 'person-member-unlock-store' || vault_id || account_number_hash. Binding both stops a store copied to another vault directory or account from opening. Distinct role from 'person-member-key-store' so the phrase store and the password store never accept each other's blob.
